paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Length
model_annotation: The line plot titled “Prompt Length vs Accuracy” illustrates the relationship between prompt length (x-axis) and model accuracy (y-axis) for two variants, labeled “mmsd” (red line) and “mmsd2” (yellow line), as described in the paper “Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm Detection.” The x-axis, labeled “Prompt Length,” ranges from 2 to 16 with integer tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy,” spans from 76.5 to 81.5, with major grid lines and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The red line (“mmsd”) begins at approximately 81.0 at prompt length 2, dips slightly to 80.5 at length 4, rises to about 80.9 at length 8, and then gradually declines to roughly 80.7 at length 16. The yellow line (“mmsd2”) starts at approximately 77.5 at length 2, drops to 76.5 at length 4, increases to 77.3 at length 8, and then steadily decreases to about 76.3 at length 16. Both lines are marked with circular data points and connected by solid lines, showing that “mmsd” consistently maintains higher accuracy than “mmsd2” across all tested prompt lengths.
